capabilities: Complete Chinese and English words from a local vault index
Suggest note links, properties, and custom dictionary phrases
Pause suggestions during IME composition until text is committed
Persist completion history and personal dictionaries in the vault
Index the vault in the background while typing
extras: Warns to enable only one autocomplete plugin at a time; settings and commands are Chinese by default; GitHub releases are not the same as Obsidian community-directory listing; mobile IME test matrix incomplete.
intentEvidence: This is an independently maintained derivative of Various Complements 11.4.2 by tadashi-aikawa.
problem: Obsidian has no offline, Chinese-first completion covering words, note links, properties, and custom phrases, and existing tools pause poorly during IME composition.
